title: Odd-region obstruction conjecture for optimal 1-embedded graphs
statement: Let $G$ be an optimal $1$-embedded graph on the torus or the Klein bottle. Let $Q(G)$ denote its quadrangulation, and call a region **odd weighted** when its associated weight is odd. **Odd-region obstruction conjecture.** If $Q(G)$ has no quadrangulation as a subgraph each of whose face corresponds to an odd weighted region of $G$, then $G$ is $1$-extendable. The paper notes that such quadrangulations provide obstructions to extendability and proposes this condition as sufficient for $1$-extendability on the torus or Klein bottle; its resolution is not supplied here.
source_name: Shohei Koizumi and Yusuke Suzuki, “The matching extendability of optimal 1-embedded graphs on the projective plane”, arXiv:2412.19074 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19074

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2024).
